descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Procedure for examining an object under a light.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Procedure for picking up one object and putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Procedure for cleaning an object and then putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Procedure for cooling an object and then putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Procedure for heating an object and then putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Procedure for picking up two objects and putting them somewhere.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says look at / examine / inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Take the object, turn on the lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use when the task is simply to put one object in/on a destination (e.g. "put a mug on the desk") with NO heating, cooling, cleaning, lamp, or second object.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to clean/wash an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet"). Cleans at a sinkbasin.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to cool/chill/cold an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table"). Cools in the fridge.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to heat/warm/hot an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop"). Heats in the microwave.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task asks to put TWO of an object kind in/on a destination (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa"). Find and place both, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for tasks like "look at X under the desklamp", "examine X with the floorlamp", or "inspect X in light". Take the object, go to the lamp, use it to turn it on. Any task mentioning a lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Load for tasks "put a/some X in/on Y" or "move X to Y" with a single object and no heated/cooled/cleaned/hot/cold/clean/lamp/two/"two" words. Plain find, take, put.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Load for tasks with "clean", "wash", or "rinse" an object then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Uses sinkbasin.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Load for tasks with "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" an object then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Uses fridge.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Load for tasks with "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" an object then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Uses microwave.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Load for tasks with "two" or a count of 2 objects, e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet". Find and place both, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load this skill when the task mentions look at, examine, or inspect an object under/with/in a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Take the object, go to the lamp, and turn it on with `use`. Any task with a lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Load for any simple "put a/some X in/on Y" or "move X to Y" task with one object (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet"). Use it when the task has no hot/heat/cool/cold/clean words, no lamp, and no "two". Find, take, put.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Load when the task says "clean", "wash", or "rinse" an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Take the object to the sinkbasin, clean it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Load when the task says "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Take the object to the fridge, cool it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Load when the task says "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Take the object to the microwave, heat it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task says "two" or asks for 2 of an object (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Find and place the first object, then find and place a second one, carrying one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for ANY task with look at / examine / inspect / see an object under, with, or in a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Take the object, go to the lamp, `use` it to turn it on.
descriptions.pick_and_place: ALWAYS load for plain "put a/some X in/on Y", "place X on Y", or "move X to Y" tasks with ONE object and no heat/cool/clean/lamp/two (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet", "put a book on the bed"). Find, take, put. Default skill for simple put tasks.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "clean", "wash", or "rinse" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Take object to the sinkbasin, clean it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Take object to the fridge, cool it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Take object to the microwave, heat it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task says "two", "2", or asks for a pair/multiple of an object (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Place the first, then find and place a second, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for ANY task with look at / examine / inspect / see an object under, with, or in a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp", "examine the book with the desklamp"). Not a put task: take the object, go to the lamp, `use` it to turn it on.
descriptions.pick_and_place: ALWAYS load for plain single-object tasks: "put a/some X in/on Y", "place X on Y", "move X to Y" (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet", "put a book on the bed", "put a pencil in the drawer"). Use whenever the task has no clean/hot/cool/lamp words and no "two". Find, take, put. Default for simple put tasks.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "clean", "wash", or "rinse" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Take object to the sinkbasin, clean it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Take object to the fridge, cool it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Take object to the microwave, heat it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "two", "2", "both", or a plural object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "put two cds in the drawer", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Take one, place it, then find and place a second different one.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for ANY task that mentions a desklamp or floorlamp, or says look at / examine / inspect / see an object in light (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp", "examine the book with the desklamp"). Take the object, go to the lamp, `use` it to turn it on. Not a put task.
descriptions.pick_and_place: ALWAYS load for ANY task of the form "put/place/move a/some X in/on/to Y" with ONE object and none of the words clean/wash/hot/heat/cool/cold/lamp/two (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet", "put a book on the bed", "put a pencil in the drawer"). Default skill for simple put tasks: find, take, put.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "clean", "wash", or "rinse" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Take object to the sinkbasin, clean it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Take object to the fridge, cool it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Take object to the microwave, heat it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task says "two", "2", "both", or a plural object to put somewhere (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "put two cds in the drawer", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Even if it is a simple put, load this instead of pick_and_place. Place the first, then find and place a second, one at a time.
